About the data

Track, pad and points: Khabri1_Opt1_Track_rev.kmz. Ground image: Sentinel-2 L2A true colour, 10 m, 31 Dec 2025 (0.03% cloud), contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025. Levels: Copernicus DEM GLO-30. River water and the 38,000 shrubs and trees are placed from the satellite water and vegetation indices, so their positions are real but their shapes are generic. Google Earth imagery is not used: its terms do not allow reuse and its servers are blocked here. The bridge is a concept, not a design: check span, deck level and HFL against a site survey and hydrology.
